Grant Thornton Bharat CASEQuest

Grant Thornton's case competition for arts and commerce undergraduates: a video prelim, semi-finals and a finale, with internships for top teams.

PRIZE POOL
₹150,000
Reward details
₹1.5 lakh cash: ₹75,000 + PPI (winner), ₹50,000 and ₹25,000 + live projects/internships for runners-up.
Registration deadline
To be confirmed
Format & location
Hybrid · Online + finale
Who can apply
BBA, BCom, BA, BSc and other arts/commerce UG students at recognised institutions. BTech students are not eligible.
Team size
3–5 participants

Entry notes

  • Registration usually runs from mid-September with the prelim in October–November; the official page doesn't show this year's dates.
